artifacts.name: demo-training-data
artifacts.description: DEMO synthetic training dataset (1,470 rows, 30 locations, 8 NER states). Canonical input, pinned by ml/model/model_meta.json dataset_sha256.

artifacts.name: demo-model
artifacts.description: Trained RandomForestClassifier (DEMO). Loaded at runtime by backend/app/ml/predictor.py.

artifacts.name: demo-preprocessors
artifacts.description: Label encoders + feature-column list used to fit the DEMO model.

artifacts.name: demo-model-meta
artifacts.description: Model metadata: version, libraries, hyperparameters, metrics, feature importances, label-leakage caveat.

artifacts.name: demo-locations
artifacts.description: 30 seeding locations across the 8 NER states used by the DEMO generator.

sources.name: landslideguard-demo-generator
sources.access_reference: In-repo generator: ml/data/generate_data.py (run as `python ml/data/generate_data.py` from the project root)
sources.license_attribution: None - generated in-repo, no third-party content (the repository has no LICENSE file)

field_mapping.transform: pass-through (column name already matches the model contract)

known_limitations: DEMO/synthetic: the label is a thresholded linear function of several of these features (label leakage), so the reported metrics are not an estimate of real-world performance (see docs/model.md).
Regeneration is seeded (random.seed(42)) and reproducible for a given Python runtime, but is not guaranteed byte-identical across Python versions; the committed CSV plus its SHA-256 is canonical.
Coordinates are representative town centroids, not verified landslide points.

notes: REAL sources are registered in this manifest by checksum only; their raw bytes live in data/raw, which is git-ignored, so large datasets never enter the repository.
No REAL source is registered yet. This manifest records the DEMO baseline only; the data acquisition phase will add REAL sources here before any real training or prediction.
